youtube.title: Why Wet Sand Looks So Much Darker 🏖️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Dry sand grains scatter light from their surfaces straight back to your eyes, so the beach looks pale. When water fills the gaps between the grains, light enters the grains and bounces around inside, where more of it gets absorbed. Less light returns to your eyes, so wet sand looks darker, with no dye or stain involved.
